newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Air Macau to take delivery of fifth Airbus.
newsitem.headline: Air Macau to take delivery of fifth Airbus.

text.p: Air Macau is to take delivery of its newest aircraft on February 22 to service the airline's growing regional network in China, an airline spokeswoman told Reuters.
The Airbus Industrie A321, with 178 seats and three tonnes of belly cargo capacity, joins a fleet of two A321s and two 150-seat A320s.
Another A321 is on order and due to be delivered in May, the spokeswoman said in an interview.

The new, leased aircraft, part of Air Macau's plan to increase its all-Airbus fleet by two aircraft per year, will be used on the carrier's existing routes and new Chinese destinations planned to begin later this year.
The first flight of a new three times a week service to Qingdao in China is due next month followed by Haikou and Wuhan at a date yet to be decided, she added.
